Origami Media (in a French report translated by DeepL) said it heard from several people close to the game's development that the idea for Beyond Good and Evil 2, in 2019-2022, was for the game to be "highly multiplayer and connected", featuring "a multitude of planets" where players would be matchmade and play together.

singleSourced.key: the key concept was the third place a spot where you might hang out with mates after work just as you would in fortnite or destiny
singleSourced.value: The key concept was the 'third place' - a spot where you might hang out with mates after work, just as you would in Fortnite or Destiny,
singleSourced.context: "The key concept was the 'third place' - a spot where you might hang out with mates after work, just as you would in Fortnite or Destiny," Origami shared, "which were cited as sources of inspiration.

You played as a blank character, tagging along on the adventures of the heroes of Beyond Good & Evil, in the passenger seat."

But since then, the project "evolved", from smaller matchmade groups to more open-ended play, then to team-based play in groups of four and finally, to pairs.
